diffs.diff: current (A), shunt register at ADCRANGE=0 with 15 mOhm: datasheet reading gives 0.000333333 per count, the part's model has 0.3333, 0.003125, 0.125, 0.5
diffs.evidence: TI INA238 datasheet (SBOSA20), VSHUNT register 04h: 'Conversion factor: 5 µV/LSB when ADCRANGE = 0; 1.25 µV/LSB when ADCRANGE = 1' (full scale ±163.84 mV at ADCRANGE=0). With the Adafruit #6349 15 mΩ shunt, 5 µV / 0.015 Ω = 333.33 µA = 0.000333333 A per count. The model's sim measure for reg 0x04 uses scale 0.33333 against the 'current' control whose unit is mA, i.e. 0.33333 mA/count = 0.000333333 A/count: the same value in different units. The other listed scales are other registers (0.003125 V/count VBUS 05h = 3.125 mV/LSB, 0.125 °C/count DIETEMP 06h = 125 m°C/LSB, 0.5 mA/count CURRENT 07h with the driver's CURRENT_LSB = 500 µA and SHUNT_CAL = 819.2e6 x 500e-6 x 0.015 = 6144). The driver also uses 5e-3 mV per VSHUNT count, consistent with the datasheet.
